facebook_reels.aspect_rules: Use vertical 9:16 video. Keep the subject centered and readable on mobile.
facebook_reels.hashtag_guidance: Use 3-8 relevant hashtags. Avoid unrelated tags.
facebook_reels.manual_upload_notes: Upload manually in Meta Business Suite or the Facebook app. No posting integration is configured.
facebook_reels.title_length_guidance: Keep the first sentence clear and scannable.

instagram_reels.aspect_rules: Use vertical 9:16 video. Avoid placing key text under app controls.
instagram_reels.duration_guidance: Prefer 7-45 seconds for tight Reels packaging.
instagram_reels.hashtag_guidance: Use 5-12 focused hashtags. Mix category, audience, and series tags.
instagram_reels.manual_upload_notes: Upload manually in Instagram. No posting integration is configured.
instagram_reels.title_length_guidance: Use a short hook line; keep caption context below it.

tiktok.aspect_rules: Use vertical 9:16 video with strong first-frame clarity.
tiktok.duration_guidance: Prefer 7-35 seconds unless the hook needs more setup.
tiktok.hashtag_guidance: Use 3-6 specific hashtags. Avoid broad filler tags.
tiktok.manual_upload_notes: Upload manually in TikTok Studio or the TikTok app. No posting integration is configured.
tiktok.title_length_guidance: Keep the title/caption hook under 120 characters when possible.

youtube_shorts.aspect_rules: Use vertical 9:16 video. Confirm the short reads well on mobile.
youtube_shorts.duration_guidance: Keep under 60 seconds for Shorts eligibility.
youtube_shorts.manual_upload_notes: Upload manually in YouTube Studio. No posting integration is configured.
youtube_shorts.title_length_guidance: Keep titles under 70 characters when possible.
